name: Bloodsport Brawler
crime: Causing a Public Disturbance & Unlicensed Pit-Fighting
biography: The Brawler is a brutal warrior trained in the bloody fighting pits of Brüttelburg & Pigskin Port, where cheering throngs bet on the lives & deaths of the unfortunates forced into battle for the entertainment of the masses. She is a rough & tough killing machine & she knows how to put on a bloody show.

Having escaped the pits, the Bloodsport Brawler did any job she could find, doing what she does best, but a raid on an illicit fight soon put her in chains once again. Nevertheless, with her unrivaled muscle & burning lust for freedom, it’s a safe bet that the Undercity Dungeon won’t hold her for long!
